# Asteroid Orbit

A simple HTML‑canvas game where the player controls a ship orbiting a planet. Asteroids drift inward; the ship can rotate around the planet and thrust outward to dodge and collect fuel pickups. The game ends (lose) when the ship collides with an asteroid or runs out of fuel.

1: // Simple asteroid‑orbit canvas game
2: // Canvas element with id="game" must exist in the HTML.
3: 
4: (() => {
5:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
6:   if (!canvas) return console.error('Canvas #game not found');
7:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
8:   // Set canvas size to match its displayed size
9:   canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
10:   canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
11: 
12:   const CENTER = { x: canvas.width / 2, y: canvas.height / 2 };
13:   const PLANET_R = 30;
14:   const SHIP_R = 8;
15:   const AST_R = 12;
16:   const FUEL_R = 6;
17: 
18:   // starfield background
19:   const STAR_COUNT = 80;
20:   const stars = Array.from({length: STAR_COUNT}, () => ({
21:     x: Math.random() * canvas.width,
22:     y: Math.random() * canvas.height,
23:     r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5,
24:   }));
25: 
26:   // sound effects (simple data‑URI wavs)
27:   const thrustAudio = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA='); // short silent placeholder
28:   const fuelAudio = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
29:   const explodeAudio = new Audio('data:audio/wav;base64,UklGRiQAAABXQVZFZm10IBAAAAABAAEAESsAACJWAAACABAAZGF0YQAAAAA=');
30:   let ship = {
31:     angle: 0,               // radians
32:     radius: PLANET_R + 40,   // distance from centre
33:     rotSpeed: 0,            // -1/0/1 per frame
34:     thrust: false,
35:     fuel: 100,
36:     alive: true,
37:   };
38: 
39:   const asteroids = [];
40:   const fuels = [];
41:   let frame = 0;
42:   let gameOver = false;
43: 
44:   // ---------- Input ----------
45:   const keys = {};
46:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => { keys[e.code] = true; });
47:   window.addEventListener('keyup', e => { keys[e.code] = false; });
48: 
49:   // ---------- Helpers ----------
50:   function polarToCart(angle, radius) {
51:     return {
52:       x: CENTER.x + Math.cos(angle) * radius,
53:       y: CENTER.y + Math.sin(angle) * radius,
54:     };
55:   }
56: 
57:   function distance(a, b) {
58:     const dx = a.x - b.x, dy = a.y - b.y;
59:     return Math.hypot(dx, dy);
60:   }
61: 
62:   // ---------- Game logic ----------
63:   function spawnAsteroid() {
64:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
65:     const radius = Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2 + 20;
66:     asteroids.push({ angle, radius, speed: 1 + Math.random() * 0.5 });
67:   }
68: 
69:   function spawnFuel() {
70:     const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
71:     const radius = Math.max(canvas.width, canvas.height) / 2 + 20;
72:     fuels.push({ angle, radius, speed: 0.8 });
73:   }
74: 
75:   function update() {
76:     if (!ship.alive) return;
77:     // input handling
78:     ship.rotSpeed = 0;
79:     if (keys['ArrowLeft']) ship.rotSpeed = -0.03;
80:     if (keys['ArrowRight']) ship.rotSpeed = 0.03;
81:     ship.thrust = keys['ArrowUp'] && ship.fuel > 0;
82: 
83:     // ship update
84:     ship.angle += ship.rotSpeed;
85:     if (ship.thrust) {
86:       ship.radius += 1; // thrust outward
87:       ship.fuel -= 0.2;
88:       // play thrust sound
89:       thrustAudio.currentTime = 0;
90:       thrustAudio.play();
91:     } else {
92:       // natural drift inward (gravity)
93:       ship.radius -= 0.3;
94:     }
95:     // keep ship within bounds
96:     ship.radius = Math.max(PLANET_R + SHIP_R, ship.radius);
97: 
98:     // asteroids update
99:     asteroids.forEach(a => a.radius -= a.speed);
100:     // fuels update
101:     fuels.forEach(f => f.radius -= f.speed);
102: 
103:     // collision detection
104:     const shipPos = polarToCart(ship.angle, ship.radius);
105:     asteroids.forEach((a, i) => {
106:       const pos = polarToCart(a.angle, a.radius);
107:       if (distance(shipPos, pos) < SHIP_R + AST_R) {
108:         ship.alive = false;
109:         gameOver = true;
110:         // play explosion sound
111:         explodeAudio.currentTime = 0;
112:         explodeAudio.play();
113:       }
114:       // remove asteroids that passed the planet
115:       if (a.radius < PLANET_R) asteroids.splice(i, 1);
116:     });
117:     fuels.forEach((f, i) => {
118:       const pos = polarToCart(f.angle, f.radius);
119:       if (distance(shipPos, pos) < SHIP_R + FUEL_R) {
120:         ship.fuel = Math.min(100, ship.fuel + 30);
121:         fuels.splice(i, 1);
122:         // play fuel pickup sound
123:         fuelAudio.currentTime = 0;
124:         fuelAudio.play();
125:       }
126:       if (f.radius < PLANET_R) fuels.splice(i, 1);
127:     });
128: 
129:     // spawn timing
130:     if (frame % 120 === 0) spawnAsteroid(); // every 2 seconds @60fps
131:     if (frame % 500 === 0) spawnFuel();
132:     frame++;
133:   }
134: 
135:   // ---------- Rendering ----------
136: function draw() {
137:     // starfield background
138:     ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
139:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
140:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
141:     stars.forEach(s => {
142:       ctx.beginPath();
143:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
144:       ctx.fill();
145:     });
146: 
147:     // planet with radial gradient
148:     const planetGrad = ctx.createRadialGradient(CENTER.x, CENTER.y, PLANET_R * 0.2, CENTER.x, CENTER.y, PLANET_R);
149:     planetGrad.addColorStop(0, '#555');
150:     planetGrad.addColorStop(1, '#111');
151:     ctx.fillStyle = planetGrad;
152:     ctx.beginPath();
153:     ctx.arc(CENTER.x, CENTER.y, PLANET_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
154:     ctx.fill();
155: 
156:     // ship as triangle, green if alive, red if dead
157:     const shipPos = polarToCart(ship.angle, ship.radius);
158:     const shipDir = ship.angle;
159:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.alive ? '#0f0' : '#f00';
160:     ctx.beginPath();
161:     ctx.moveTo(
162:       shipPos.x + Math.cos(shipDir) * SHIP_R,
163:       shipPos.y + Math.sin(shipDir) * SHIP_R
164:     );
165:     ctx.lineTo(
166:       shipPos.x + Math.cos(shipDir + Math.PI * 0.8) * SHIP_R * 0.6,
167:       shipPos.y + Math.sin(shipDir + Math.PI * 0.8) * SHIP_R * 0.6
168:     );
169:     ctx.lineTo(
170:       shipPos.x + Math.cos(shipDir - Math.PI * 0.8) * SHIP_R * 0.6,
171:       shipPos.y + Math.sin(shipDir - Math.PI * 0.8) * SHIP_R * 0.6
172:     );
173:     ctx.closePath();
174:     ctx.fill();
175: 
176:     // asteroids with simple gradient
177:     asteroids.forEach(a => {
178:       const p = polarToCart(a.angle, a.radius);
179:       const grad = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, AST_R * 0.2, p.x, p.y, AST_R);
180:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#aaa');
181:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#555');
182:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
183:       ctx.beginPath();
184:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, AST_R, 0, Math.PI * 2);
185:       ctx.fill();
186:     });
187: 
188:     // fuel pickups with glow gradient
189:     fuels.forEach(f => {
190:       const p = polarToCart(f.angle, f.radius);
191:       const glow = ctx.createRadialGradient(p.x, p.y, 0, p.x, p.y, FUEL_R * 2);
192:       glow.addColorStop(0, 'rgba(255,255,0,0.8)');
193:       glow.addColorStop(1, 'rgba(255,255,0,0)');
194:       ctx.fillStyle = glow;
195:       ctx.beginPath();
196:       ctx.arc(p.x, p.y, FUEL_R * 2, 0, Math.PI * 2);
197:       ctx.fill();
198:     });
199: 
200:     // HUD
201:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
202:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
203:     ctx.textAlign = 'left';
204:     ctx.fillText('Fuel: ' + Math.floor(ship.fuel), 10, 20);
205:     if (gameOver) {
206:       ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.6)';
207:       ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
208:       ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
209:       ctx.textAlign = 'center';
210:       ctx.font = '32px sans-serif';
211:       ctx.fillText('Game Over', canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);
212:     }
213:   }
214:   }
215: 
216:   function loop() {
217:     if (!gameOver) update();
218:     draw();
219:     requestAnimationFrame(loop);
220:   }
221: 
222:   // start the game
223:   loop();
224: })();

(End of file - total 224 lines)
</content>
